_about: Map editor guide (editor menu > HOW IT WORKS): title, picture, paragraphs. Pictures are the real editor playing a demo; put assets/howto/<picture>.png to use your own.

pages.title: THE GRID
text: Your map is a grid of spots. The round dots are OUTPOST spots, the lines between them are LINK spots, and the gaps between four outposts are DIAGONAL spots.
ARROWS move the yellow corners. The bottom bar always says what the spot is and what ENTER will do.

pages.title: OUTPOSTS
text: ENTER on an outpost spot cycles it: NONE, OUTPOST, BARRACKS, then back to NONE.
NONE leaves a hole in the map. A BARRACKS (+1) gives one extra soldier every turn to whoever holds it.

pages.title: LINKS
text: ENTER on a link: NONE, ROAD, RIVER, BRIDGE.
Roads and bridges: everyone passes. Rivers: only helicopters, but anyone shoots across. NONE: a forest or mountains in battle, nobody gets through.
On a diagonal spot, ENTER adds diagonal roads: one way, the other, or both.

pages.title: MOVING AN HQ
text: Each side always has exactly one HQ. ENTER on an HQ picks it up, and it floats with your cursor.
Press ENTER on any outpost spot to drop it there; the spot it left becomes a plain outpost. ESC puts it back.

pages.title: MIRROR
text: With MIRROR ON, every change is copied to the opposite side, turned around, so both armies get the same map. Moving one HQ moves the other too.
Turn MIRROR off in the menu to build an uneven scenario.

pages.title: SAVE AND PLAY
text: Go UP from the top row (or press ESC) for the menu: save, size, theme and name.
SAVE writes the map into the maps folder, next to the built-in ones. Play it from CHOOSE A BATTLEFIELD.
Share a map by sending its file; drop a friend's file into maps to play it.

pages.title: GENERATED MAPS AND RESETS
text: + GENERATE MAP in the map list builds a fair, mirrored map from a few settings. REROLL until you like it, then SAVE IT, or EDIT IT first.
Messed up a map that came with the game? RESET TO DEFAULT in the editor menu puts the original back.
